teaser.en: Walk out on the lagoon flats at low tide and the soft green carpet underfoot is often this underwater flowering plant.
teaser.sw: Tembea kwenye nyanda za mahori wakati wa maji kupwa, na zulia laini la kijani lililo chini ya miguu yako mara nyingi ni mmea huu unaotoa maua chini ya maji.

summary.en: Round-tipped seagrass is a flowering plant that lives fully submerged, forming meadows on the intertidal flats of the lagoons. These meadows shelter the fish, octopus and sea cucumbers that Digo fishers depend on.
summary.sw: Nyasi bahari hii yenye ncha za mviringo (*round-tipped seagrass*) ni mmea unaotoa maua unaoishi ukiwa umezama kabisa, ukiunda mbuga kwenye nyanda za mahori zinazofunikwa na kufunuliwa na maji. Mbuga hizi huwahifadhi samaki, pweza na majongoo bahari ambao wavuvi wa Kidigo wanawategemea.

about.en: Round-tipped seagrass is not a seaweed but a true flowering plant, with roots, creeping stems and flat, strap-like leaves. As its name says, the leaf tips are smoothly rounded, which helps to tell it from its neighbours. The leaves grow in small bunches from stems buried in the sand, forming low, dense meadows.
about.sw: Nyasi bahari hii yenye ncha za mviringo si mwani bali ni mmea halisi unaotoa maua, wenye mizizi, mashina yanayotambaa na majani bapa kama kanda. Kama jina lake la Kiingereza linavyosema, ncha za majani ni za mviringo laini, jambo linalosaidia kuitofautisha na nyasi bahari jirani. Majani huota katika mafungu madogo kutoka kwenye mashina yaliyofukiwa mchangani, yakiunda mbuga fupi zilizosongamana.

where.en: It grows on the intertidal flats of the lagoons, where it may be exposed or only just covered at the lowest tides. Seagrass meadows fringe Gazi Bay, Diani-Chale and Vanga-Shimoni. A spring low tide is the best time to see it, when the flats are open and the meadows lie in shallow, warm pools.
where.sw: Huota kwenye nyanda za mahori zinazofunikwa na kufunuliwa na maji, ambapo inaweza kuachwa wazi au kufunikwa kidogo tu wakati wa maji kupwa kabisa. Mbuga za nyasi bahari huzunguka Ghuba ya Gazi, Diani-Chale na Vanga-Shimoni. Bamvua la maji kupwa ndio wakati bora wa kuiona, nyanda zikiwa wazi na mbuga zikiwa katika vidimbwi vya maji ya joto yasiyo na kina.

uses.en: Its meadows are habitat for the rabbitfish, parrotfish, octopus and sea cucumbers that Digo fishers depend on. They also trap sediment, keeping the lagoon water clear and helping to protect beaches.
uses.sw: Mbuga zake ni makazi ya tafi, pono, pweza na majongoo bahari ambao wavuvi wa Kidigo wanawategemea. Pia hunasa mashapo, na hivyo kuweka maji ya mahori safi na kusaidia kulinda fukwe.

names.en: No Digo name has been recorded yet. Swahili speakers usually call sea plants in general *mwani*. In English it is round-tipped seagrass, and its scientific name is *Cymodocea rotundata*.
names.sw: Bado halijarekodiwa jina la Kidigo. Wazungumzaji wa Kiswahili kwa kawaida huita mimea ya baharini kwa jumla *mwani*. Kwa Kiingereza inaitwa *round-tipped seagrass*, na jina lake la kisayansi ni *Cymodocea rotundata*.

conservation.en: The seagrass meadows of Gazi Bay, Diani-Chale and Vanga-Shimoni are feeding grounds for dugongs, green turtles and rabbitfish, and nurseries for young fish.
conservation.sw: Mbuga za nyasi bahari za Ghuba ya Gazi, Diani-Chale na Vanga-Shimoni ni malisho ya nguva, kasa na tafi, na malezi ya samaki wachanga.

reason.en: Same family; shares the intertidal flats
reason.sw: Familia moja; hushiriki nyanda zinazofunikwa na kufunuliwa na maji

reason.en: Grows in the same lagoon meadows
reason.sw: Huota katika mbuga zilezile za mahori
